Name: Hashabiah
Summary: A Levite brought from Casiphia who guarded the temple treasure, repaired the wall, and sealed the covenant.
KeyVerses: Ezra 8:19; Ezra 8:24; Nehemiah 3:17; Nehemiah 10:11; Nehemiah 11:15; Nehemiah 11:22; Nehemiah 12:21; Nehemiah 12:24
LifeLesson: Faithful hands carry both treasure and trowel.
